queries.query: large language model AND "network operations" OR NetOps OR "network configuration" "LLM" "configuration generation"
queries.rationale: High-level discovery of work using LLMs directly for NetOps tasks (config generation, intent translation, workflows).
source_preferences: IEEE/ACM conferences and journals (SIGCOMM, NSDI, INFOCOM, IMC, TNSM)
ACL/EMNLP (for LLM methods applied to systems)

queries.rationale: Papers and systems that translate operator intent or NL policies into device configurations.
source_preferences: vendor docs (Cisco, Juniper) for intent-based networking

queries.rationale: Search for generate–repair or LLM-based configuration correction and rollback approaches.
Find architectures pairing generation with validators or repair loops (generate→validate→repair).

queries.query: Batfish OR "Header Space Analysis" OR Veriflow OR NetPlumber "network verification"
queries.rationale: Locate formal/deterministic network verification tools used for checking configuration correctness and reachability.
Methods for validating network changes before deployment and safety mechanisms (staging, canary, rollback).
source_preferences: operator blogs with reproducible artifacts (only if primary code/docs available)

queries.query: AIOps OR "LLM for AIOps" benchmark OR dataset "network"
queries.rationale: Benchmarks and datasets aimed at automation/ops tasks that could inform evaluation design.
Direct search for the named benchmark leads and their descriptions, datasets, and evaluation protocols.

queries.query: "evaluation metrics" "network configuration" correctness semantics syntactic reachability "LLM"
queries.rationale: Literature on operationally meaningful metrics (syntactic validity, semantic correctness, reachability, policy compliance).
Work discussing differences between simulation testbeds and production networks and implications for evaluation.
Find literature on LLMs that call external tools/APIs (e.g., verifiers) and patterns (ReAct, Toolformer) applicable to NetOps.
Work on agentic/autonomous agents in operational contexts and safety/trustworthiness concerns.
Papers characterizing hallucination risks and mitigation strategies in safety-critical tasks relevant to NetOps.
Research on adversarial inputs/attacks at both the network-config and model levels (poisoning, prompt attacks).
Standards and tooling around structured configuration languages (YANG/NETCONF) that affect parseability and validator design.
Operational toolchains (GitOps, CI/CD) and their testing/validation processes for safe NetOps change management.
Best practices and tools for literature verification and reproducible experimental records required by the programme.
Methodological guidance on experimental design, paired comparisons, and failure-mode analysis relevant to NetOps studies.
Work on program/patch repair and code synthesis as analogies or transferable methods for configuration repair.
Literature discussing validity threats specific to benchmarks and tasks in operations domains to inform evaluation criteria and threat model.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, workshop papers, arXiv preprints) that directly address LLMs/AI applied to NetOps or configuration tasks.
Tool and benchmark papers with publicly available artifacts or repos (Batfish, Mininet, ns-3, benchmark code).
Standards and authoritative technical docs (IETF, vendor configuration references) when relevant to correctness evaluation.
Methodology papers on experimental design, evaluation metrics, and reproducibility applicable to systems/NetOps research.
Security and safety literature (adversarial ML, operational safety) that informs failure modes and mitigations.
Seminal foundational works (e.g., Header Space Analysis) even if pre-2018, when they underpin verification techniques.
exclusion_criteria: Unofficial blog posts or press summaries without primary artifacts or references, unless they link to replicable code or papers.
Commercial marketing material without supporting technical detail or reproducible artifacts.
Works solely about unrelated LLM benchmarks (e.g., purely generative-text benchmarks) that do not touch NetOps/operational validation.
Papers that only mention networks peripherally without substantive methods/results for configuration correctness, validation, or operations.
date_rationale: Search window: prioritize 2018–2026 to capture the LLM era and recent NetOps+AI work; include older seminal foundational papers (e.g., Header Space Analysis, Batfish origins) where necessary for verification and tooling context. Final retrievals should be current up to 2026-08-30.
